tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The near-black page ground. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Panels that rise one step, like Elfoqsy's column.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and popovers on a surface.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Selected rows, hovered items, overlays.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the outer map ring.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and input borders. Decorative (1.6:1); never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders. 2.0:1 on bg-canvas, below the 3:1 target: always pair it with a label or a fill.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and headline text. 17.5:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and labels. 11.1:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and meta. 6.8:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Dimmed headline when all is quiet; large text only (3.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Skobeloff. Elfoqsy's identity only: her portrait ring, agent circles, threads. Never a status. Large shapes and 24px+ text only (3.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of brand-primary.

tokens.name: brand-primary-text
tokens.usage: Skobeloff as small text or thin icons on dark grounds (11.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on brand-primary fills (4.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-fox
tokens.usage: Elfoqsy's jacket. Identity only: her portrait, brand moments. Never a status.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Broken. Filled shape with a halo. The loudest colour on screen.

tokens.name: status-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger as text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: status-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger message.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning. Outline only, never a fill, so it never competes with danger.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning message.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success. Brief confirmations; it fades back to neutral.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a success message.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info: neutral news that needs no action.

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: Info as text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of an info message.

tokens.name: status-needs-you
tokens.usage: Waiting for you: an agent or Elfoqsy needs the user. Yellow everywhere it shows: headline, message frame, agent halo and step segment.

tokens.name: status-needs-you-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a message that waits for the user.

tokens.name: status-todo
tokens.usage: To do: filled gray-600, as in Jira.

tokens.name: status-in-progress
tokens.usage: In progress: filled blue-500, as in Jira.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked: filled red-500, as in Jira.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done and Released: filled green-500, as in Jira and GitHub. Small dots in the lower left corner of the map.

tokens.name: status-cancelled
tokens.usage: Cancelled: hollow 1.5px gray-400 ring, kept apart from done in the upper left corner of the map.

tokens.name: agent-running
tokens.usage: Elfoqsy's agents only: the filled agent circle. Never a ticket status.

tokens.name: agent-outline
tokens.usage: Elfoqsy's agents only: an agent at work, Skobeloff outline. Never a ticket status.

tokens.name: line-structure
tokens.usage: Structure lines: priority rings and PR orbits, 1.5px. Brighter was too loud, darker invisible.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Ticket-type and pull-request glyphs inside filled status circles.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset 2px.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical 1. Boards, epics or sources on small tags and chart series, never on status shapes.

tokens.usage: Categorical 2.

tokens.usage: Categorical 4.

tokens.name: cat-5

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical 6.

tokens.name: cat-7

tokens.name: cat-8

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Counts in the status cluster, top left of both screens.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The time after the calendar tile, tabular.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines such as the brief view's header, in text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body and inputs; never below 16px in inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Ring names and legends. Smallest size allowed.

scale.note: Every font size in the workspace is one of these steps (tokens.css: --font-size-*). Nothing is under 12px except the calendar tile's month band.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside glyph groups.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill and legend gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Node to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside cards; gaps in Elfoqsy's column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; header to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the map and Elfoqsy's column.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Screen side padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Legend glyphs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The bug diamond.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, message bubbles, Elfoqsy's portrait.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Nodes, pills, the you dot.

tokens.name: halo-needs-you
tokens.usage: Ring around a node that needs you.

tokens.name: halo-danger
tokens.usage: Ring around a broken node.

tokens.name: halo-selected
tokens.usage: Selection ring on the selected ticket (ui-spec: 4px gap, 2px ring).
